name: Pipamperone
aliases: Carpiperone, dipiperone, floropipamide, Floropipamide, Fluoropipamide, R 3345, R-3345
summary: Pipamperone (INN, USAN, BAN), sold under the brand name Dipiperon, is a typical antipsychotic of the butyrophenone family used in the treatment of schizophrenia and as a sleep aid for depression. It is or has been marketed under brand names including Dipiperon, Dipiperal, Piperonil, Piperonyl, and Propitan.

pharmacology.text: Pipamperone acts as an antagonist of the 5-HT2A, 5-HT2B, 5-HT2C D2, D3, D4, α1-adrenergic, and α2-adrenergic receptors. It shows much higher affinity for the 5-HT2A and D4 receptors over the D2 receptor (15-fold in the case of the D4 receptor, and even higher in the case of the 5-HT2A receptor), being regarded as "highly selective" for the former two sites at low doses.

uses.text: Pipamperone was developed for use as an antipsychotic in the treatment of schizophrenia. Pipamperone might be useful as a hallucinogen antidote or "trip killer" in blocking the effects of serotonergic psychedelics like psilocybin.

sideEffects.en: Common effects include drowsiness, dizziness and low blood pressure on standing. Like other antipsychotics it can cause stiffness, tremor and restlessness, and rarely neuroleptic malignant syndrome, a serious reaction with fever and rigid muscles.
sideEffects.zh: 常見副作用包括嗜睡、頭暈和起身時血壓偏低。和其他抗精神病藥一樣，它可能引起肌肉僵硬、顫抖和坐立不安，少數情況下會出現抗精神病藥惡性症候群，這是一種伴隨發燒和肌肉僵直的嚴重反應。
sideEffects.zhHans: 常见副作用包括嗜睡、头晕和起身时血压偏低。和其他抗精神病药一样，它可能引起肌肉僵硬、颤抖和坐立不安，少数情况下会出现抗精神病药恶性症候群，这是一种伴随发烧和肌肉僵直的严重反应。

fact.en: Pipamperone was discovered at Janssen Pharmaceutica in Belgium in 1961. It belongs to the same butyrophenone family as haloperidol, which came from the same laboratory a few years earlier.
fact.zh: 醯胺哌啶酮於 1961 年在比利時的楊森藥廠被發現。它和氟哌啶醇同屬丁醯苯類，而氟哌啶醇幾年前也出自同一間實驗室。
fact.zhHans: 酰胺哌啶酮于 1961 年在比利时的杨森药厂被发现。它和氟哌啶醇同属丁酰苯类，而氟哌啶醇几年前也出自同一间实验室。
